items.name: use-yuva-discussions
items.title: Yuva discussions hooks
items.description: A React provider and hooks over the useyuva headless client: discussions of a page, one thread, reader sign-in, the channel's discussion mode and page ratings. Labels with English defaults.

items.name: yuva-discussion-composer
items.title: Yuva discussion composer
items.description: A Markdown composer with Write and Preview tabs for new discussions, replies and edits, and the reader sign-in prompt.

items.name: yuva-discussion-list
items.title: Yuva discussion list
items.description: The discussions of a page with New, Top and Unanswered tabs, answered and locked badges, votes and reply counts.

items.name: yuva-discussion-thread
items.title: Yuva discussion thread
items.description: One discussion: the opening post, the accepted answer, replies one level deep, votes, follow, accept, edit and delete, and the reply composer.

items.name: yuva-discussions
items.title: Yuva discussions
items.description: Discussions for a documentation page, like GitHub Discussions: the list with sort tabs, threads, accepted answers, replies, votes, a composer with preview, reader sign-in and follow.

items.name: yuva-page-feedback
items.title: Yuva page feedback
items.description: "Was this page helpful?" with yes and no, sent to Yuva as a page rating.

items.name: use-yuva-subscribe
items.title: Yuva subscribe hook
items.description: A React hook over the useyuva headless client: the channel's public mailing lists, subscribing from a form with its form token, and the signed-in user's subscriptions with an identity token.

items.name: yuva-subscribe
items.title: Yuva subscribe form
items.description: A mailing list sign-up form: e-mail, optional name, a checkbox per list, an unticked consent box whose sentence is stored as shown, and a switch per list for signed-in users.

items.name: use-yuva-chat
items.title: Yuva chat hook
items.description: A React hook over the useyuva headless client for live chat: the session, conversation list, one thread with realtime messages, typing, read state, sending text and files, rating and attachment download. Labels with English defaults.

items.name: yuva-chat-thread
items.title: Yuva chat thread
items.description: One conversation: grouped messages, day separators, system events, attachments, link bubbles, typing, seen state, a top fade and a scroller that sticks to the bottom with a jump-to-latest pill showing the unread count.

items.name: yuva-chat-composer
items.title: Yuva chat composer
items.description: A message box with chips for attached files, an attach button, an optional screenshot button, an Enter to send hint and a send button.

items.name: yuva-chat-conversations
items.title: Yuva chat conversations
items.description: The visitor's conversations as rows with the last message, time and an unread dot, and an empty state.

items.name: yuva-chat
items.title: Yuva chat
items.description: Live chat for a page or an app: header with the agent's avatar and reply time, conversation list, thread, composer and the e-mail confirmation card, in a plain card or a lined variant.

items.name: use-yuva-help
items.title: Yuva help hooks
items.description: React hooks over the useyuva headless client for the inbox's help center: the center with its collections and the best matches for the page, debounced article search that counts a submitted search, and one article with its Yes and No rating. Labels with English defaults.

items.name: yuva-help-search
items.title: Yuva help search
items.description: A search field over the help center with live results: the matched words highlighted in the title and excerpt, and the click counted for the report.

items.name: yuva-help-article
items.title: Yuva help article
items.description: One help article with its sanitized body, a Was this helpful? Yes and No rating, related articles and a Message us button that hands the article id to your chat.

items.name: yuva-help
items.title: Yuva help
items.description: The help center in one block: search, the best matches for the page or the popular articles, collections, the article view with its rating and related articles, and a Message us row.
